_readme: Membrane material library for membrane_check.py / material_select.py. fw/ff = strip tensile strength warp/weft in kN/m (1 kN/m = 1 N/mm; conversions: N/5cm ÷ 50, daN/5cm ÷ 5, N/3cm ÷ 30, lb/in × 0.17513). 'raw' = value and unit as published; 'strength_basis' says whether it is a mean, minimum, nominal or 5 % fractile; fk_w/fk_f = characteristic 5 % values where published (used by --method partial / ts19102). 'status': datasheet = manufacturer sheet read at source_url; excerpt = manufacturer value seen only as a search excerpt (URL not retrievable); class-table = published classification table (JRC132615 Eurocode Outlooks); published-example = value used in a published worked example; typical = industry typical, NOT verified. All values are for screening and benchmarking: design with the supplier's certified strength (5 % fractile) and biaxial data for the delivered batch. ETFE: fw = f_y10 × t (10 % strain stress), not UTS. family_defaults selection fields are TYPICAL family figures (status typical).
